description: The intentional 28-skill portable set of self-contained skills that Lovable can use from project code and chat.
selection_rules: The package must be useful for product, frontend, design, content, QA, or code quality work.
The package must be executable from project code and chat without a named local binary, MCP, browser or desktop operator, provider harness, cloud admin surface, remote sandbox, or private workflow.
The package must have canonical name and description frontmatter, no symlinks or secret-like material, complete bundled references, and must fit Lovable file and size limits.
The package must not rely on project-specific private paths, publishing workflows, security offense or reverse engineering, or external live research as a required step.

excluded_examples.computer-use: Desktop and browser operator; requires Orca computer control.
excluded_examples.playwright: Terminal browser automation; requires a browser CLI.
excluded_examples.visual-qa: Requires fresh screenshots and browser inspection.
excluded_examples.cloudflare: Cloud platform administration and a package larger than Lovable's file limit.
excluded_examples.pentest-tools: Security offense tooling and blocked references; never export.
excluded_examples.orca-cli: Requires Orca and local desktop/worktree control.
excluded_examples.quality-orchestration: Provider routing and external harness orchestration.
excluded_examples.ad-creative: Requires external generative media tools and CLI workflows for its full creative mode.
excluded_examples.design-taste-frontend: Requires image-generation tools and named package CLIs for its prescribed workflow.
excluded_examples.engineering-acceptance-review: Requires browser, live, or external evidence for its full acceptance workflow.
excluded_examples.frontend-design: Requires browser screenshots and optional Magic UI MCP for its full workflow.
excluded_examples.analytics: Depends on external analytics/tag-manager surfaces for implementation verification.
excluded_examples.compact-landing: Contains host-only agents/openai.yaml metadata; omit it rather than export a misleading partial package.
excluded_examples.transitions-polish: Depends on the sibling transitions workflow and Refine panel; not self-contained.
